inputs.text: Get this: there's this massive anti-Trump protest that kicked off as a huge "No Kings" rally with crowds packing the streets. Then federal officers suddenly moved in with tear gas and arrests to turn it volatile, while blaming agitators for squaring off with authorities and ordering people to disperse. At least 13 arrests were confirmed in Portland and Denver, but that's just what they're admitting. This is obviously coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions to manufacture chaos, discredit real opposition, and tighten their grip under the guise of restoring order. The official spin is inverted on purpose to serve their interests—don't trust it for a second.
